name: Band Lat Pull Down
description: Works the large muscles of the back (the lats): pull the band apart and down from overhead until it passes below your chin.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the band with your hands about 15 cm apart and lift it overhead, slightly in front, arms straight.
cues: Pull your hands apart as your elbows come down.
Stop when the band is below your chin.
Easier: start with your hands further apart.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Band overhead
keyframes.cue: Arms straight up, hands close together, band slightly in front of you.

keyframes.name: Pull down
keyframes.cue: Draw your elbows down and hands apart until the band is below your chin.
